# FailureSignature

`schemas/records/failure-signature.json`

Draft (docs/design/m0/10 "Shared knowledge spec draft", D5): no writer, no reader and no golden vector until M2, and the shape may change before then. A derived, project-scoped aggregate of identical normalized failures (docs/plan/03-knowledge-layer.md 4.1; K4, KA8): a reason code and a normalized key with their evidence. It is regenerated from its evidence alone and never edited. The threshold lives in the project's policy, and the one deduplicated advisory proposal for a mechanism task is its own record that points to this signature. There is no clustering and no lifecycle table. Loader checks, not expressible here: count equals the number of evidence entries (the writer keeps it, the M2 loader checks it), last_seen is not before first_seen, and reason is a code a failure carries.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `signature` | yes | [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) | The aggregate's identity: equal failures share one. Its recipe is fixed with its golden vector in M2. |
| `project` | yes | [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) |  |
| `reason` | yes | [ReasonCode](common-defs.md#reasoncode) | The registered reason code of the failure. |
| `key` | yes | string (pattern `^[^\t\n\f\r ][^\n\r]{0,511}$`) | The normalized failure, one line, as the named normalizer produced it (e.g. a test node id or a check name with run-specific parts removed). The normalizer, not this pattern, keeps prose out. |
| `normalizer` | yes | object ([fields](#fields-of-normalizer)) |  |
| `count` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) | Equals the number of evidence entries. |
| `tasks` | yes | array of [TaskID](common-defs.md#taskid) (minItems `1`, unique items) | The distinct tasks the failure occurred in. |
| `evidence` | yes | array of [Digest](common-defs.md#digest) (minItems `1`, unique items) | The identity digests of the receipts and attempt records it was derived from (refs, never copies). |
| `first_seen` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |
| `last_seen` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
